Texts: ['①. Spend <color=#0E70BD>Battleforged Modules</color> to swap portraits; <color=#0E70BD>Battleforged Modules</color> can be obtained through event missions.', '②. Once you have spent a certain number of tokens, no more tokens will be consumed in the current stage.']
['①. Tap a portrait to select it. You can swap the selected portrait with one of the <color=#0E70BD>4 adjacent portraits</color>.']
['①. Match 3 identical portraits in a row or column to eliminate them.', '②. Accumulate a certain number of eliminations to earn rewards.']

['①. Tap to enter Tactical Override <color=#0E70BD>chapters</color>. Only <color=#0E70BD>specified characters</color> can be used in each <color=#0E70BD>chapter</color>.', '②. Tap the <color=#0E70BD>Event Mission</color> button to go to the <color=#0E70BD>Claim Event Rewards</color> page.']

["①. Tap here to view the character's <color=#0E70BD>Basic Tutorial</color>.", '②. This area displays the <color=#0E70BD>Hypertune effects</color> added to characters in the chapter.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Complete missions</color> in a stage to <color=#0E70BD>claim event rewards</color>.', '④. There are <color=#0E70BD>three difficulty levels for stages</color> in a chapter. Tap here to switch between them.']

['①. View stage <color=#0E70BD>mission objectives</color> here.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>Tap</color> to select and deselect a grid. <color=#0E70BD>Hold and drag</color> for quick multi-selection. Empty grids cannot be selected.', '③. Get enough thread ball grids into the <color=#0E70BD>finish basket</color> to complete its objective and record the score at the finish point.']

['①. After completing the <color=#0E70BD>1-star objective</color>, you can clear the stage with the current stage state.', '②. Current stage score.', '③. Tap the <color=#0E70BD>Hint button</color> to view hints. Tap the <color=#0E70BD>Reset button</color> to reset the stage.']

['①. View the functions of some grids in the current stage here.', '②. Thread ball grids with a value of <color=#0E70BD>1</color> can be <color=#0E70BD>dyed</color>.', '③. Thread ball grids with a value of <color=#0E70BD>10</color> can be <color=#0E70BD>dyed</color>.', '④. Thread ball grids with a value of <color=#0E70BD>1</color> <color=#0E70BD>cannot be dyed</color>.']

['①. You can shoot out dye to <color=#0E70BD>color thread balls</color> at the finish point.', '②. You can shoot out dye with a <color=#0E70BD>larger dyeing area</color> at the finish point.', '③. You can shoot out <color=#0E70BD>thread balls of the corresponding color</color> at the finish point.']

['①. View <color=#0E70BD>victory objectives</color> and <color=#0E70BD>special card rules</color> here.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>Change the assistant character</color> here.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>View opponent and switch games</color> here.', "④. Complete games to earn <color=#0E70BD>Valentine's Day event items</color> and use them to <color=#0E70BD>unlock character dating stories</color>.", '⑤. Claim <color=#0E70BD>event rewards</color> or view <color=#0E70BD>character dating stories</color> here.']

["①. Both players in the game <color=#0E70BD>play cards face-down</color>. When you play a card bigger than your opponent's, you earn <color=#0E70BD>the points of the card</color>.", "②. You can <color=#0E70BD>play your cards based on your opponent's reactions</color>.", "③. In each game, you can <color=#0E70BD>use help</color> to <color=#0E70BD>change your own or your opponent's cards</color>.", '④. Both players have <color=#0E70BD>completely identical</color> cards. Cards will only be revealed once they are confirmed and played.']
["①. You can use <color=#0E70BD>Valentine's Day event items</color> earned from games to invite characters and unlock their <color=#0E70BD>dating stories</color>."]

['①. Here you can <color=#0E70BD>select new Structural Modifications</color> or <color=#0E70BD>upgrade already selected Structural Modifications</color>.', '②. You can view <color=#0E70BD>selected Structural Modifications</color> here. You can perform up to 4 Structural Modifications in total.']

['①. Here you can <color=#0E70BD>select new Universal Modifications</color> or <color=#0E70BD>upgrade already selected Universal Modifications</color>.', '②. Here you can view <color=#0E70BD>already selected Universal Modifications</color>. Structural Modifications and Universal Modifications can be active simultaneously.', '③. Here you can <color=#0E70BD>refresh the Universal Modifications list</color>.', '④. The number of <color=#0E70BD>Universal Modifications</color> you can perform increases as you progress.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Reach the target score</color> within the time limit to clear the stage.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>Stage time</color> will <color=#0E70BD>gradually decrease</color> as you progress through the stage.', '③. Every <color=#0E70BD>3 grabs</color> of items grants a <color=#0E70BD>point reward</color>. The more items of the same type you collect, the more points you earn.', '④. Use the buttons to <color=#0E70BD>move the ship left or right</color> and <color=#0E70BD>launch or retract the grappling hook</color>.']

['①. Path of Buried Wishes has 9 battles, unlocking gradually as you progress and over time.', '②. You gain Charge Points by completing battles or passively over time.', '③. When Charge Points reach halfway, you can open a Charge Chest to receive ADD-on rewards.']
['①. Each battle has multiple Arenas you can challenge.', '②. The final Arena of each battle records your clear time and displays it on the leaderboard.']
['①. In Arena Enhancement, you can spend Carnage Crystals to power up your team.', '②. In the ADD-on Codex, you can purchase ADD-ons and reset ADD-on Quantum Affixes.']

["①. Challenging arenas grants character ADD-ons, Premium Vouchers, Winner's Cores, and Carnage Crystals. First clears also give extra rewards.", '②. Each Arena has different combat traits, which you can view in the Details section.']
['①. Spend <color=#0E70BD>Dreamcatchers</color> to challenge stages.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>Dreamcatchers</color> can be obtained through event missions.']

['①. Light up safe areas to increase corresponding progress.', '②. The numbers on the grid represent the count of <color=#0E70BD>Spider Webs</color> within the <color=#0E70BD>3x3 grid area</color>.', '③. If you tap on a safe area, all the safe areas within the <color=#0E70BD>3x3 grid area</color> will light up.']
['①. If you tap on a <color=#0E70BD>Spider Web</color>, only that grid would light up.', '②. This also increases your accumulated failure progress by 1.']

['①. The stage content will remain the same when you challenge it again, and you will obtain more challenge attempts.', '②. If you fail to clear a stage, you can replay the stage without consuming an attempt.']
['①. Light up all safe areas to clear the stage and receive rewards.', '②. The corresponding sequence will also be unlocked.']
["①. Here you can view each character's skills and icons. Different character types are equipped with different skills."]

['①. Swipe the screen to move your character. Press and hold the screen to choose a direction. Collide with units on the map to interact.', '②. Crucial Kuroro carries a special mark. Collide with it to eliminate it.', '③. Eliminate crucial Kuroro to activate the endpoint. Move your character to the endpoint to complete the stage.', "④. Tap Celica's Portrait to get hints."]
['①. Tap the puzzle to view more info. There are many different features. Make sure you read them.']

['①. Before the race begins, tap here to <color=#0E70BD>predict</color> the results.', '②. Before the Points Race ends, you can tap here to predict <color=#0E70BD>results</color>.', '③. Tap here to view the <color=#0E70BD>match schedule</color>, past results, and replays.']

['①. Tap here to claim free <color=#0E70BD>SFX Coatings</color> and <color=#0E70BD>Weapon Coatings</color>.', '②. Open the Stellar Ranking to view the <color=#0E70BD>global prediction leaderboard</color>. Scores are based on the total tokens earned from correct predictions.', '③. Tap <color=#0E70BD>Party Booster</color> to view event missions and the event shop.']

['①. Tap here to switch <color=#0E70BD>prediction categories</color>.', '②. Here you can view <color=#0E70BD>character stats</color> and <color=#0E70BD>skills</color>. <color=#0E70BD>Signature Moves</color> can only be cast after collecting enough Signal Orbs on the track.', '③. Tap here to make <color=#0E70BD>predictions</color> about characters.']

['①. Tap here to switch to <color=#0E70BD>Director View</color>, where the system controls the camera automatically.', '②. Tap here to switch to <color=#0E70BD>Character View</color>, where the camera follows your character.', "③. Tap here to view the current character's <color=#0E70BD>skill info</color> and <color=#0E70BD>Signal Orb info</color>.", '④. When passing a <color=#0E70BD>Supply Point</color>, the character picks up a random Signal Orb based on their <color=#0E70BD>Luck</color> and <color=#0E70BD>skill requirements</color>, gaining its effect.']

['①. Red Signal Orb: Grants a brief <color=#0E70BD>speed boost</color> when picked up.', '②. Yellow Orb: Grants temporary <color=#0E70BD>debuff immunity</color> when picked up.', '③. Blue Orb: When picked up, throws Cogs to <color=#0E70BD>attack</color> a random character ahead.', '④. Rainbow Orb: A rare drop that unleashes a flurry of Black Cards to <color=#0E70BD>attack</color> all other characters when picked up. It can also act as a Signal Orb of <color=#0E70BD>any color</color> when using skills.']
['①. Spend a specified number of <color=#0E70BD>Black Gold Bear Cards</color> to unlock stages.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Press and hold</color> an icon, then drag to <color=#0E70BD>connect two identical icons</color>. Once connected, all the <color=#0E70BD>blocks</color> along the path will be <color=#0E70BD>lit up</color>.']
['①. When both the <color=#0E70BD>number of connected icons</color> and the <color=#0E70BD>number of blocks lit up</color> reach the target, you can claim the clear reward.']

['①. Connecting Lines: A new line can <color=#0E70BD>overwrite</color> an already connected line. Use "Reset" to <color=#0E70BD>reset</color> all the connected icons in the current stage.', "②. Hollow Tiles: You can't connect lines across Hollow Tiles. Try going around them."]

['①. The Godfall Revelation includes two modes: <color=#0E70BD>Story Mode - Path of Revelation and Matchmaking Mode - Desperado Clash</color>. Path of Revelation lets you experience the full story, while Desperado Clash pits you against other Commandants.']
['①. Choose a character to explore their story and <color=#0E70BD>advance their unique path</color>.']
['①. In Path of Revelation mode, <color=#0E70BD>uncover clues through various events</color> to progress the story.']
['①. After collecting enough clues, you can <color=#0E70BD>begin calculation</color>.']
['①. <color=#0E70BD>Select the correct clues</color> based on the questions and advance the story simulation step by step.']

['①. Tap here to select a character for this challenge.', '②. In Desperado Clash mode, each character has independent points. Win battles to earn points, <color=#0E70BD>raise your rank</color>, and claim <color=#0E70BD>Honor Rewards</color>.', '③. You may freely use the story-themed Coatings during gameplay.']

['①. Desperado Clash requires consecutive battles. Each victory grants 1 badge; collect <color=#0E70BD>10 badges</color> to <color=#0E70BD>complete the challenge</color>. Each defeat costs 1 HP. When <color=#0E70BD>HP runs out</color>, the challenge <color=#0E70BD>ends early</color> and point rewards are tallied.', '②. Here on the right side are the skill slots. Equip selected skills to use them in battle.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Before each battle</color>, characters can enter the Mysterious Tavern for <color=#0E70BD>battle preparation</color>. On rounds <color=#0E70BD>1, 3, 5, 7, and 9</color>, you may <color=#0E70BD>select one skill</color> for free to add to your inventory.']

["①. In Mysterious Tavern, you can spend<color=#0E70BD> gold to purchase Runes</color>. Runes enhance a character's base stats and grant them <color=#0E70BD>special abilities</color>. As the battles progress, the quantity and rarity of Runes available in Mysterious Tavern will gradually improve.", '②. Rune slots are at the center. Equip purchased Runes there to activate them in battle.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Spend coins to unlock</color> additional Rune <color=#0E70BD>slots</color>. The cost decreases each round, down to a minimum of 1 coin.', '④. Refresh to instantly update the items in the tavern. Use "Freeze" to prevent selected items from being refreshed.']

['①. Skills and Runes are labeled with <color=#0E70BD>tags</color> for clarity, which includes 5 <color=#0E70BD>attribute tags</color> and 7 <color=#0E70BD>archetype tags</color>. Runes bearing attribute tags can boost their respective <color=#0E70BD>attributes</color> when certain battle conditions are fulfilled.']

['①. In The Godfall Revelation, there are 7 <color=#0E70BD>main archetypes</color> of Runes, plus a few without a defined archetype. Runes with the same <color=#0E70BD>archetype tag</color> share similar <color=#0E70BD>combat styles</color>.']

['①. In The Godfall Revelation, characters engage in fully automated one-on-one battles using their equipped skills and Runes. The side whose HP drops to zero first loses the battle.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>30 seconds</color> into the battle, <color=#0E70BD>Death Speed</color> begins. Both sides continuously lose HP until one is defeated.', '③. During battle, the sides of the screen show the <color=#0E70BD>skills</color> used by each side, while the bottom shows the <color=#0E70BD>Runes</color> triggered by each side.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Level</color> up to gain <color=#0E70BD>ATK</color> and <color=#0E70BD>HP</color>.', '②. Unlock <color=#0E70BD>accessories</color> at specific levels to enhance combat power or economic profits.']
['①. <color=#0E70BD>Alchemy Hammer</color> can enhance 5★ Runes, further improving their combat power.']

['①. Upon accepting a commission, you can view its <color=#0E70BD>completion conditions</color> and associated <color=#0E70BD>Blessings</color>, including their strength at each rank and the cost to rank up.', "②. Tap the <color=#0E70BD>Refresh</color> button to replace a commission you don't want. This can be done only once per slot."]

['①. After a commission is accepted, the <color=#0E70BD>commission progress</color> is displayed above. Tap Blessing to review <color=#0E70BD>commission details</color>. Use the button below to spend coins for a <color=#0E70BD>Blessing Rank-Up</color>. You may rank up only once per turn. Once the commission is completed, you cannot perform further rank-ups.']
['① In Desperado Clash, once you collect <color=#0E70BD>10 badges</color>, you can choose to start <color=#0E70BD>extra games</color>. The result of extra games will affect your final points.']
['①. Bubble Block: Merge it to the target size to increase the Dream Depth and clear the board.', '②. Dormant Wavelength: The size your Bubble Block needs to reach to trigger an upgrade.']

['①. Clearing Pattern: The <color=#0E70BD>arrow direction</color> on a Bubble Block shows which rows or columns will be cleared. For example, if the arrows point up, left, and right, all blocks above and on the same row will be cleared.']

["①. When a block has a <color=#0E70BD>border</color>, it means it's currently within the clearing area.", "②. When a block's number is too small, upgrading it will <color=#0E70BD>turn it into a Stone Block</color>.", '③. Dream Depth: Increases by 1 after each clear.']

['① Current Steps: Number of actions taken.', '②. Enhanced Moves: Level up to enter Fluffy Time and gain Enhanced Moves, during which the <color=#0E70BD>numbered blocks generated become larger</color>.', '③. Special blocks that will appear in the current level. Tap to view details.']

['①. Score: Earn points whenever you clear or merge blocks.', '②. Dream Level: Shows how close you are to the target Dream Level based on your score.', '③ Tap the upper right corner to finish early.']

['①. Star Block: Can merge with any numbered block except Bubble Blocks.', '②. Heart Block: After 3 merges, Bubble Blocks <color=#0E70BD>instantly reach the target size</color>.', '③. Clump Block: When nearby blocks <color=#0E70BD>move and hit</color> it, the Clump Block breaks. The number shows how many hits it takes.']

['①. Cool Block: Can merge with numbered blocks. When merged with a Hot Block, it randomly keeps one element.', '②. Hot Block: Can merge with numbered blocks. When merged with a Cool Block, it randomly keeps one element.', '③. Tap to clear blocks of the same element. The remaining ones <color=#0E70BD>turn into Star Blocks</color>.']
['①. Spend <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color> to flip cards. <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color> can be obtained through event missions.']
['①. Flip cards that meet the requirements at the same time to <color=#0E70BD>clear</color> them.', '②. Each stage has different <color=#0E70BD>clear requirements</color>.']

['①. Each stage has its own <color=#0E70BD>limit</color> for how many cards can be <color=#0E70BD>flipped at the same time</color>.', '②. If you reach the limit but still <color=#0E70BD>do not meet the clear requirements</color>, a set number of cards will be <color=#0E70BD>flipped back</color>.']
['①. After flipping a certain number of cards, you can continue flipping cards in the current stage without consuming <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color>.']
['①. Clear a specified number of cards in the stage to claim the corresponding rewards.']
['① 疾速追缉共有四个关卡，每个关卡拥有三个难度。']

['① 玩法默认开启困难，噩梦难度，炼狱难度需要通关<color=#0E70BD>上一难度</color>后解锁。', '② Tap here to view <color=#0E70BD>enemy move details</color> for all Challenge Missions.', '③ Each bounty target features multiple missions that offer rewards upon completion.', '④ Certain difficulties are limited to specific characters.']
['① Each bounty target features multiple missions that offer <color=#0E70BD>rewards</color> upon completion.', '② Tap here to view <color=#0E70BD>enemy move details</color> for Challenge Missions.']

['①. There are <color=#0E70BD>four areas</color> that unlock over time and based on progress. Each area has its own mission objectives.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>Red</color> blocks are currently being cleared and <color=#0E70BD>can be challenged</color>. Clearing them <color=#0E70BD>unlocks the next blocks</color>.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Blue</color> blocks have already been cleared and are temporarily unavailable. The <color=#0E70BD>top-right icon</color> shows whether the current block is a <color=#0E70BD>battle block</color> or a <color=#0E70BD>minigame block</color>.']

['①. Clearing stages has a <color=#0E70BD>chance to drop collectibles</color>, which are shown in real time on the details page. Owning <color=#0E70BD>orange collectibles</color> <color=#0E70BD>increases the overall Trial Prototype drop multiplier for cleared stages</color>.', "②. Tap before entering a battle to view the stage's <color=#0E70BD>collectible drop types</color> and <color=#0E70BD>expected rewards</color> upon completion.", '③. Before starting a battle or dispatch, you can <color=#0E70BD>tap to use items</color>. After it ends, the items will be lost and your <color=#0E70BD>chance of obtaining rare collectibles</color> will increase.']

['①. Whether it is a battle or a dispatch, you will <color=#0E70BD>contribute</color> to the server <color=#0E70BD>clearing progress</color>. This progress resets every <color=#0E70BD>5</color> minutes.', '②. When the server clearing progress is at 100%, all Commandants on the server receive <color=#0E70BD>rewards</color>. Each block grants different rewards.', '③. Consume <color=#0E70BD>Floating Processors</color> to perform <color=#0E70BD>dispatches</color> or join <color=#0E70BD>battles</color> to earn <color=#0E70BD>Contribution, tokens, and random collectibles</color>. <color=#0E70BD>Higher battle ratings</color> grant <color=#0E70BD>more Contribution and tokens</color>.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Floating Processors</color> <color=#0E70BD>replenish over time</color>, with a maximum storage capacity of 480.', '②. The new <color=#0E70BD>Collection Room feature</color> is now available and can be accessed from the main interface. Here, you can view all owned collectibles, <color=#0E70BD>trade collectibles</color>, and level up the room.']

['①. Tap a collectible to view its <color=#0E70BD>detailed information</color>.', '②. Provide the required collectibles here to <color=#0E70BD>upgrade the Collection Room</color> and unlock access to <color=#0E70BD>more collectible types</color>.', '③. Here, you can go to the Auction House to <color=#0E70BD>trade collectibles</color>, or visit the Rare Codex to submit <color=#0E70BD>rare collectibles</color> and earn a <color=#0E70BD>one-time reward</color>.']

['①. Tap to filter by <color=#0E70BD>collectible type</color>.', '②. Switch between <color=#0E70BD>purchasing and selling</color> here.', '③. Tap a collectible to <color=#0E70BD>purchase</color> it, which costs a certain amount of tokens.']

['①. Drag the slider to <color=#0E70BD>purchase multiple collectibles</color> at once.', '②. The price shown here is a <color=#0E70BD>reference rate</color> based on bulk purchases. In reality, items will be purchased one by one at the current lowest market price.']

['①. You can choose <color=#0E70BD>Bulk Listing</color> to sell collectibles using the <color=#0E70BD>default market price</color>.', '②. Tap <color=#0E70BD>items currently for sale</color> to <color=#0E70BD>remove them from the listing</color>.', '③. Tap a collectible to <color=#0E70BD>set price and quantity</color> and list it in the Auction House.']

['①. When selling collectibles, you can <color=#0E70BD>adjust the price and quantity</color> within a set range.', "②. This shows your <color=#0E70BD>expected income</color>. If the item sells within 24 hours, you'll receive that income. Otherwise, <color=#0E70BD>the sale fails and the collectible returns to your Collection Room</color>."]
['①. <color=#0E70BD>Consume 1 rare collectible</color> to unlock its entry in the codex and claim a <color=#0E70BD>one-time collection reward</color>.']

['①. The rhombus blocks are missions that require your <color=#0E70BD>independent completion</color>, including Special Missions and Support Missions. The mission progress is not affected by the server progress, and completing them grants <color=#0E70BD>fixed tokens and Contribution</color>.', '②. Special Missions and Support Missions <color=#0E70BD>refresh automatically every day at 5:00 (UTC)</color>.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Clearing</color> <color=#0E70BD>all unlocked blocks</color> commences the <color=#0E70BD>Repeated Simulation</color> period, which lasts until a <color=#0E70BD>new block is unlocked</color> or the event ends.', '②. During <color=#0E70BD>Repeated Simulation</color>, all <color=#0E70BD>cleared blocks</color> become <color=#0E70BD>available for challenge</color>.']

['①. Clearing a Character Block unlocks a <color=#0E70BD>trial of that character</color> for the entire server, and the character receives a <color=#0E70BD>battle boost</color>.', '②. Clearing a Supply Block grants <color=#0E70BD>Trial Prototypes</color> to the entire server for <color=#0E70BD>reward exchange</color>.', '③. Clearing a Strategic Block grants <color=#0E70BD>Trial Prototypes</color> to the entire server for <color=#0E70BD>reward exchange</color>.', "④. Clear the Base Station block to reveal <color=#0E70BD>all the area's paths</color> and unlock a new <color=#0E70BD>Battle Report Notice</color>.", "⑤. Each area's objective is to clear Dark Blocks. Doing so grants <color=#0E70BD>a large amount of Trial Prototypes</color> for <color=#0E70BD>reward exchange</color>.", '⑥. <color=#0E70BD>High-risk Dark Blocks</color> appear in Area IV as <color=#0E70BD>limited-time challenges</color>. Make sure to clear them promptly.']

['①. When a block is <color=#0E70BD>cleared</color>, all Commandants on the server will receive its <color=#0E70BD>clear rewards</color>. Blocks of <color=#0E70BD>different types</color> offer <color=#0E70BD>different rewards</color> when cleared.']
['①. As the <color=#0E70BD>server progress</color> increases, more Battle Reports will be gradually <color=#0E70BD>unlocked</color> in the Battle Report Notice.']

["①. Once you get your <color=#0E70BD>Trial Prototypes</color> from <color=#0E70BD>solo</color> or <color=#0E70BD>server rewards</color>, don't forget to <color=#0E70BD>exchange for rewards</color> at Special Supplies. As the <color=#0E70BD>server progress</color> increases, more <color=#0E70BD>features</color> will be unlocked."]

['①.<color=#0E70BD>Every hour</color>, the tokens are tallied.The<color=#0E70BD>unclaimed</color> tokens will<color=#0E70BD> remain </color>until you claim them.', '②.Gain Trial Prototype tokens <color=#0E70BD>automatically</color> over time after <color=#0E70BD>the Dark blocks are cleared</color>.The more Dark Blocks cleared, the higher the hourly token yield is.']

['①. Movement Controls: <color=#0E70BD>Swipe or tap buttons to move your character. On PC, you can use the WASD keys.</color>', '②. Rescue as many <color=#0E70BD>Benign Code Blocks</color> as possible.', '③. Victory Condition: Rescue enough <color=#0E70BD>Code Blocks</color>, then exit through the logic block endpoint to win.']
